description: Temperate East Asia: bamboo brakes, feral rice paddies, persimmon orchards and tea terraces gone wild. Hot wet summers under the plum rains; dry bitter winters on the Siberian wind.
name: East Asian Temperate Forest

fall.note: Harvest. Persimmons, chestnuts, rice. Fatten up.

spring.note: Greens return. Bamboo shoots push up — the hungry season's exit.

summer.note: The plum rains, then typhoon season. Hot, wet, everything grows — including the mosquitoes.

winter.note: The Siberian wind. Dry, bitter, still. Stored food or nothing.
